commits.change: Single _pendingApproval routing slot replaced with an arrival-ordered pending Queue<ApprovalGateView> (bound 8; overflow auto-denies the oldest gate so its DecisionRecorded waiter always wakes). DrainGateQueue now appends every queued gate and enqueues it; TryRouteApprovalKey/TryRouteApprovalClick serve the OLDEST pending gate and dequeue it on decision; resolved-off-path gates are pruned before routing. ApprovalGateView.Id is now instance-unique (approval:{n}:{toolName}) — the old approval:{toolName} collided for same-tool gates.
commits.tests: Harbor.Tui.CellForge.Tests ApprovalGateViewTests 12/12 pass; ChatScreenBridgeTests 17/17 pass; temp acceptance harness (2 consecutive bash gates accepted in arrival order, no zombie IsPending, ids distinct; overflow auto-deny) 2/2 pass, harness removed before commit.

commits.change: ScreenBuffer.SetStyleAt skipped Wide lead cells (returned false), so PanelFx.BlendRegion left wide glyphs stale-colored and could half-recolor a pair via its WSkip tail. Writes now restyle the full lead+tail cluster and route tail hits to their lead; tail cells are rebuilt with Cell.From(Rune(0)) which resolves to WSkip width. VirtualizedChatTimeline.Append's per-append O(n) budget rescan replaced with a running total (adjusted on Append/ReplaceLast/Replace/Evict); eviction now triggers only when the total crosses BudgetBytes and evicts down to a 75% low-water mark in one pass instead of evicting every append.
commits.tests: Harbor.Tui.CellForge.Tests PanelFxTests 8/8 pass (incl. BlendRegion style-only and golden SGR tests, Budget eviction test); temp harness verified lead+tail restyle, tail routing, no stale colors after BlendRegion, and 20k appends with eviction complete in tens of ms — harness removed before commit.

commits.change: RunAsync finally awaited backend.WriteAsync(leave-alt-screen) BEFORE modeController.Restore(); a throwing write skipped Restore and left Windows consoles in raw/VT mode. The write is now wrapped in try/catch (logged via ILogger, no silent swallow) so Restore() runs unconditionally; Unix path and public API unchanged, no hot-path allocations.
commits.tests: Harbor.Tui.CellForge.PtyTests 54/57 pass (3 environment-flaky failures on first run, passed on re-run; not sprint regressions).

commits.task: Follow-up — permanent acceptance tests for task 1
commits.change: The temp acceptance harness for the two-consecutive-bash-gates criterion was removed before commit 4c7c84f; replaced with three permanent tests: TwoConsecutiveBashGates_ResolveInArrivalOrder_NoZombies (arrival-order routing, no zombie IsPending, id distinctness), RequestApprovalGate_TwoGates_RoutedInArrivalOrder_OnTick (off-thread queue drains both gates in one tick, oldest-first), and Id_IsUniquePerInstance_ForSameToolGates.

876862b fixed SetStyleAt to route WSkip writes to their lead, but PanelFx.BlendRegion still iterated over every cell including WSkip tails. On a tail iteration the loop read the tail's blank/default style (WideTail has Fg=0), faded it, and routed SetStyleAt back to the lead — overwriting the wide glyph with a double-faded blank. BlendRegion now skips WSkip cells; SetStyleAt continues to handle the lead+tail cluster. Added regression test BlendRegion_WideChar_PreservesStyleAcrossLeadAndTail.
